text:
The post-graduation work permit (PGWP) allows students who have graduated from [eligible designated learning institutions (DLIs)](/en/immigration-refugees-citizenship/services/study-canada/study-permit/prepare/designated-learning-institutions-list.html) to gain valuable Canadian work experience.

Graduating from a designated learning institution (DLI) doesn’t automatically make you eligible for a PGWP.

* [Check the DLI list](/en/immigration-refugees-citizenship/services/study-canada/study-permit/prepare/designated-learning-institutions-list.html) to find out which schools have eligible programs.

As of November 1, 2024, the [eligibility requirements](/en/immigration-refugees-citizenship/services/study-canada/work/after-graduation/eligibility.html) for a PGWP changed. Most PGWP applicants now need to give proof of language results when they apply.

If you submitted your PGWP application before November 1, 2024, or are a flight school graduate, you’re exempt from the new requirements.
The length of your PGWP depends on the level and duration of your study program, as well as the [expiry date of your passport](#expired), whichever comes first.
section_heading: How long is a post-graduation work permit valid?

text:
You can apply for a 3-year PGWP, even if your master’s program was less than 2 years, as long as

* your program was at least 8 months (or 900 hours for Quebec programs) **and**
* you meet all other eligibility requirements

This **doesn’t** apply to certificate or diploma programs.
section_heading: How long is a post-graduation work permit valid? — For master’s degree programs as of February 15, 2024

text:
We may give you a PGWP that’s valid for up to the same length as your study program.

For example, if you completed a 9-month program, we may give you a work permit for up to 9 months.
section_heading: How long is a post-graduation work permit valid? — If your program was at least 8 months (or 900 hours for Quebec credentials), but less than 2 years

text: We may give you a PGWP that’s valid for 3 years.
section_heading: How long is a post-graduation work permit valid? — If your program was 2 years or more

text:
You may be able to get a PGWP that combines the length of each program as long as you meet the eligibility requirement for **each** program.

For example, if one of the programs has a higher language requirement, you need to **meet the higher requirement** to get a PGWP that combines the length of both programs.

Each of the programs you completed must be

* PGWP eligible **and**
* at least 8 months (or 900 hours for Quebec credentials) in length

You can’t get a PGWP if you already had one after completing an earlier program of study.
section_heading: How long is a post-graduation work permit valid? — If you completed more than 1 program

text:
Make sure your passport is [valid](/en/immigration-refugees-citizenship/services/passport-travel-document.html) for the full length of time you’re eligible for a PGWP before you apply.

Your work permit will only be issued for the period your passport is valid. If your passport expires before the full duration of your eligibility, you can apply to extend your PGWP.

To extend your PGWP, you must [apply on paper](/en/immigration-refugees-citizenship/services/study-canada/work/after-graduation/apply.html) after you get a new passport that’s valid for the entire period you’re eligible for the work permit.
